implementationCommitLocator: Containing implementation commit; exact resulting hosted run required
scope: Explicit trusted extracted-candidate side-by-side schema2 HTTP package staging without activation or cutover
candidateBehavior: Run only from an explicitly trusted extracted schema2 candidate with exact source-runtime and raw candidate-manifest consistency pins; no installed-launcher or source-build fallback.
Inspect the checked source installation using the candidate inspector rather than assuming old installed commands exist.
Refuse unsafe/equal/nested roots, existing target, unsupported schema/profile, recorded dependency drift, changed payloads and unknown source files.

Under the source staging lock, verify all registered sessions are clean prepared/stopped with no live owned native processes and clean controller state; copy only the current confirmed HTTP input. Retain and recheck original files and records.
Use only an owned private temporary declarative backup to create a fresh separate target with new installation/session/revision identities and no copied runtime binding/history.
Require a different actual runtime payload; report operator and native-binary changes separately. Provenance-only changes are not distinct runtime packages.
Leave the target prepared and unbound; execute only the existing native version/dependency/syntax checks, without starting a serving daemon or activating a service.
Preserve a partially created target for operator inspection on refusal and clean only the command-owned temporary backup.

command: --test-name-pattern=^installed package-info identifies checked nonexecuted payload without state or lock writes$
separateActualNodeNonexecutedInstallatio.scope: Actual Node CLI with explicitly NONEXECUTED synthetic native payload; not stage or native acceptance.

hostedVerification.expectedEvidence: Actual historical operator payload versus candidate bytes, strict refusal controls, fresh unbound target, preserved source files, no native activation, owned uninstall and existing service regressions.

acceptedPriorPackageIdentity.scope: Read-only installed package identity and existing scoped regressions; not acceptance of changed staging code.

limitations: Executing a candidate installer requires explicit operator trust; checksums are consistency observations, not signatures, package authenticity or malicious same-UID isolation.
The same-UID source lock and repeated snapshots are cooperative observations, not an OS-level process/filesystem/supervisor fence or an atomic live-state migration.
Native -V and -t checks can execute and open operator-supplied configuration references; no claim of zero native execution is made.
Staging creates a stopped unbound target only; activation, cutover, application readiness, state compatibility, upgrade and rollback require separate actual evidence.
Historical real operator CLI bytes with an unchanged compiled native binary demonstrate an operator-package difference, not a native NGINX binary version change or a permanent published package.
TLS backup/restore, external files, application/database state, in-flight requests, transaction rollback and semantic TLS connection migration are unsupported by this stage.
Local pure/tempfile/virtual controls are not physical native/process-group/signal/systemd acceptance; physical fixtures run only in supported hosted CI.
Prior local cleanup FAIL_UNKNOWN, inherited CLA failure, unexercised actual failure containment and unresolved historical causes remain preserved in mandatory checkpoint history.
Meaningful reviewed A-to-B-to-A/state compatibility, permanent distribution, independent published replay,60-minute soak, fullG3/G4/V1 and semantic Continuum remain open.
